alex: Quick heads-up  saw a couple of broken links and 403 images in the internal KB runbook previews. Scan attached: /internal/scans/8745. Anyone available to triage? :wave:
kb-scan-bot: kb-scan-bot: 2024-07-02T09:10:00Z - Linkcheck: 5 broken links, 6 image 403s in /kb/runbooks and /kb/onboarding. Report: /internal/scans/8745
priya: I can pick this up. Which runbooks specifically?
alex: runbook:redis-cache.md, runbook:kv-cache-tuning.md, onboarding/setup-local.md. Images like redis-diag.png and kv-annot.png are 403ing. Also one dead shortlink to cloud-buckets internal doc.
henry: Ill take redis and kv runbooks. Plan: rehost images to CDN, update links, and add a short note in the top of each MD about image hosting policy. Priya can take onboarding shortlink fix.
priya: yep I'll replace the shortlink with canonical /internal/cloud/storage and open a tiny PR.
henry: sed snippet I'll use: ```sh
git checkout -b fix/8745-rehost
for f in $(git grep -l "s3.internal.redwood" -- "kb/**/*.md"); do
  sed -i "s|https://s3.internal.redwood|https://cdn.redwood-infer.com|g" "$f"
  git add "$f"
done
git commit -m "docs(rehost): move kb images to CDN (fixes 403s)"
git push origin fix/8745-rehost
```
alex: can you add Cache-Control notes in the PR description? Screenshot images should be long-lived. gifs can be lower TTL.
henry: will do. Also will add alt text improvements for a11y while I'm in there.
priya: PR #3214 created for shortlink replacement, tagging @henry for cross-review.
alex: thanks. Target merge today if CI passes. I'll run a quick staging preview once merged.
kb-scan-bot: kb-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled after merge. Monitor /internal/scans/8745/status
henry: PR pushed, 6 files changed. Tagging @alex for smoke test.
alex: LGTM, merging now. Will post results after preview.
